g.text: CHAPTER II • HANDI & DUM PUKHT
Folio 03
MENUQR ROYAL ARCHIVES • ESTD 1924
THE DUM PUKHT TRADITION
THE SECRET OF THE COPPER HANDI
Awadhi Gosht Dum Biryani
Two-year aged Himalayan extra-long Basmati and pasture mutton layered in a heavy copper degh,
hermetically sealed with whole-wheat dough. Steamed over embers with Meetha Ittar and saffron.
Accompaniment: Burani Garlic Raita & Mirchi Ka Salan
Murgh Musallam Khas
Whole tender spring chicken slow-braised in an opulent almond, melon seed and saffron jus,
stuffed with spiced minced meat, golden sultanas and whole roasted pine nuts.
Crowned with silver vark, farm quail eggs & fried almonds
THE PROTOCOL OF THE PURDAH STEAM
THE IMPERIAL DUM CANON OF AWADH • 1590
"The sacred canon of Dum Pukht — not even a breath of steam shall escape,"
"Until the intoxicating perfume of the degh has enraptured the entire court."
"To seal the copper degh with whole-wheat dough and weight it with coals
is to create a universe where meat cooks only in its own marrow juices.
Zero steam escapes the vessel until it arrives before the king.
The moment the golden crust is sliced open with an antique dagger,
a cloud of Kashmiri saffron and rose ittar envelops the banquet in ecstasy."
— Dastur-e-Pakwan • Ain-i-Akbari (Imperial Cookery Annals, 1590)
DUM PUKHT
MQR
HERMETIC SEAL
CHAPTER II • HANDI & DUM PUKHT
Folio 04
MENUQR ROYAL ARCHIVES • ESTD 1924
THE 18-HOUR COAL EMBER
DAL BUKHARA & NALLI NIHARI
Dal Bukhara 18-Hour Simmer
Whole black urad lentils slow-simmered overnight over smouldering charcoal embers with sun-ripened
tomatoes, fresh garlic, white churned cow butter and pure cream. Velvety, smoky, iconic.
Nalli Nihari Khas
Prime marrow shanks simmered from twilight to dawn with 32 medicinal herbs and roghan glaze,
served with bone marrow reduction, fresh ginger matchsticks and hot green chillies.
THE ART OF PATIENCE • OVERNIGHT EMBER SIMMER
"Patience is the sacred fire that transmutes humble lentils into royal nectar;"
"And time is the master chef that renders every flavor immortal."
"Simmered from the twilight prayer through midnight until dawn awakens the city.
The low embers do not rush the lentils; they coax their innermost richness into the butter."
— Ustad Ataullah Khan • Master Chef, Imperial Court of Delhi
THE SOMMELIER'S CELLAR • VINTAGE PAIRINGS
Grover Zampa Chêne Grand Réserve
Tempranillo & Shiraz aged 15 months in French oak barrels. Dark cherry, cacao and spice.
KRSMA Cabernet Sauvignon, Hampi Hills
Full-bodied, structured ripe cassis and black pepper pairing effortlessly with Nalli Nihari.
Royal Badam Kesar Thandai
Chilled full-cream milk steeped with crushed almonds, poppy seeds, and Damascus rose water.
